title: BECE Basic Technology & Computer Science - Basic Technology - Metal Materials
subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Ferrous metals are metals that contain ________ as their main constituent.
questions.explain: Ferrous metals are defined by containing Iron (Fe). Examples include Cast Iron and Steel.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: An alloy is best defined as:
options: A pure metal extracted from ore
A mixture of two or more metals, or a metal and a non-metal
questions.explain: An alloy is a mixture created to enhance properties. For example, Brass is an alloy of Copper and Zinc.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which furnace is specifically used to produce Pig Iron from Iron Ore?
questions.explain: The Blast Furnace is used to smelt iron ore into pig iron. The Cupola furnace is used for cast iron.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Which non-ferrous metal is known for being lightweight and resistant to corrosion, often used in aircraft bodies?
questions.explain: Aluminum is lightweight and does not rust, making it ideal for aerospace applications.
questions.subject: Basic Technology

questions.q: Stainless Steel is an alloy of Steel and:
questions.explain: Stainless steel contains Chromium (and often Nickel) which gives it resistance to rust.
questions.subject: Basic Technology
